remarks: Live on top of the world in this light & spacious top floor corner apartment with invigorating cross breezes, sky-high ceilings, hardwood floors & fireplace! Rent includes heat, hot water & parking. Located on the brim of sophisticated & exciting downtown Stamford, this apartment offers pre-war features and detailing; 9' ceilings, hardwood floors, fireplace, French doors and arches. Cooks will enjoy the newer & very cool industrio-chic kitchen w/breakfast bar. Spa-inspired marble bath, living room with fireplace and super large master bedroom complete the sunny space.  Laundry and decent size Private Storage Room in Lower Level.  This special place is not to be missed! You could soon be taking in the sunshine & cross breezes while enjoying a glass of wine! Please use showingtime.
